subject: Credentialing sprint for Sentinel Capital exec workshop - June 30
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@sentinelcap.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Credentialing sprint for Sentinel Capital exec workshop - June 30

Hi Sam / team —

Thanks again for hosting us for the executive workshop on June 30. To make arrival day smooth for your security desk and the executive assistants, we want to run a short credentialing sprint this week and lock final lists. Action items below — aiming to close by EOD Monday (Jun 22):

1) Attendee manifest: final attendee names + government ID types (driver's license / passport) — we need exact match to printed ID.
2) Badge printing window: confirm if badges will be printed onsite by 08:30 or if we should pre-print and deliver.
3) Temp badge rules: max duration, escort requirement, and whether badges must be returned at exit.
4) Vendor & escort policy: please confirm if Redwood escorts require vendor background check or if your in-house escorts are required.
5) Evidence requests: we will share our SOC 2 link, insurance certificate, and background-check attestations. Please advise preferred secure upload method.

Attachments: cred-checklist.pdf (checklist of required fields for badge), proposed-escort-roster.csv (initial suggestion).

Marissa / Ben / Tessa — I put you on copy for execution. Ben, can you draft the escort roster and confirm backup cells? Marissa, can you confirm printing logistics with the vendor? Tessa, please prepare the SOC 2 pointer and insurance file for secure upload.

Sam, if you have any additional constraints (metal detector, separate VIP lane, pre-clear ID scan), flag them now and we’ll adapt.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+d1 (555) 010-2345

---
Attachments: cred-checklist.pdf (application/pdf), proposed-escort-roster.csv (text/csv)
From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@sentinelcap.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sentinel Capital Security <security@sentinelcap.com>, procurement@sentinelcap.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Credentialing sprint for Sentinel Capital exec workshop - June 30

Dylan —

Appreciate the heads up. A few items from our side before you finalize manifests: 

- We require government ID name matching for all visitors; please send full legal names and ID type by EOD Monday (Jun 22).
- Escorts that are not on Sentinel’s vendor roster must provide a vendor background-check summary; if Redwood cannot provide that, one of our vetted escorts can be assigned (we charge a nominal fee, covered under procurement).
- We need a Certificate of Insurance with liability coverage listed; please upload to our secure intake portal: https://secure-upload.sentinelcap.com/upload/xyz123
- For executive arrivals, we offer an accelerated VIP lane if you provide arrival windows (H1: 08:00–08:30 or H2: 09:00–09:30). Please indicate which window you prefer.

Also, can you confirm whether Redwood staff will need building badges for the full day or temporary visitor badges that expire at 18:00?

Thanks,
Sam Lee
Security Operations Manager
Sentinel Capital
sam.lee@sentinelcap.com
T: (617) 555-0199

Thanks Sam — that's all reasonable and expected. Quick replies inline: 

- Full legal names + ID types: we will circulate the final manifest by Monday 22 Jun EOD.
- Vendor background checks: Redwood can provide background-check attestations for our staff; I will upload the summary for escorts that are Redwood employees. If Sentinel prefers to assign in-house escorts we will support that.
- Certificate of Insurance: attaching insurance-cert.pdf to the Drive folder; Tessa will push the PDF to your secure link today.
- Arrival windows: prefer H1 (08:00–08:30) for executive drop-off; smaller group arrives 09:00 if needed. Please reserve the VIP lane for the 08:00 slot.
- Badge type: temporary visitor badges that expire at 18:00 are fine; we will ensure return at exit.

Marissa / Ben — priority: make sure escort roster includes home addresses (for vendor-check only), phone, and company ID number. Ben, draft this as a CSV and send back so we can upload.

Sam — we can also provide a one-time scan CSV export that the kiosk uses to pre-populate fields; let us know if you want that format.

Thanks —
Dylan

- We require that any external escorts who will be unsupervised on the floor be on our vendor roster with background checks; Redwood employee escorts are acceptable provided you upload the background-check summary to https://secure-upload.sentinelcap.com/upload/xyz123 by 48 hours before the event (cutoff: 2026-06-28T14:00:00-04:00).
